Machine Learning Engineer Intern - Applied AI

In this role you will train and evaluate deep learning models and ship them to production behind Python APIs.

Responsibilities:
Train, fine-tune and evaluate transformer models in PyTorch for text and vision tasks
Build data pipelines with Pandas and NumPy, run experiments and ablations, and track results
Serve models with FastAPI and ONNX, measuring latency and accuracy
Prototype LLM features using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agents with LangChain

Qualifications:
Must have strong Python and PyTorch experience
Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, statistics and model evaluation
Experience with deep learning (CNNs, Transformers) on real datasets

Preferred:
Experience with reinforcement learning or forecasting is a plus
Familiarity with Docker and GCP
Publications or open-source ML projects
